notes.title: The Bonus Levels Update
notes.content:
This update includes Music optimization. Load optimization. Graphics optimization. A new and better coin usage mechanic. And, ..... 🥁  ...... BONUS LEVELS.

Anyone can access the bonus levels that have obtained a checkpoint coin by getting all the checkpoints in at least one story level.

Accessible through the Upgrades Shop.

Rory's Swamp Bonus Level:
Floating swamp balls, spike shells, swamp terrain, Lilly pad jumping, and all sorts of stuff that will put your reflex to the test!!!

https://i.imgur.com/PdL2REf.png

Mystic Maze:
A long glowing maze full of color that requires well timed shrink drive and reflexes.

Scotty's Wild Run:
A very very difficult Voltanis scene bonus level with bizarre floating platforms going randomly all over. It also has tiny hill jumps in lava, and giant spire dodging.

Bonus Levels should be fun for Veteran players to get a new challenge and Wonderful for new players or people just starting to explore planet surfer to dip their toes a little further into how the game will play once they progress past some of the early levels.

Players can use all the abilities in the bonus levels even if they haven't unlocked them yet and can enjoy the game mechanics of jumping, phase dashing, slowing time (which haha yeah has consequences some times), and maybe even figuring out that you sorta can get an extra jump in some times when you slightly brush against a wall and we like that.

You now must unlock 15 checkpoint tokens to use the skin shop.

You get 5 checkpoint tokens for beating any bonus level for the first time.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 (Graphics Profiiles, Speed Optimization, and Foilage)
notes.content:
Users can now switch between Low, Medium, High, Very High, and Ultra graphics profiles allowing planet surfer to be a better experience for people across varying devices.
 Updates to a few of the early levels re-introducing foliage. (more of this on the way).
 New secret benefits and possibilities for users that make it to level 30+

notes.title: Early Access Vision/Manifesto
notes.content:
Now is your chance to play with all the skins already unlocked from the start because within the next three months we will have objectives in place to unlock each of the skins.

 Players who are serious over achievers and get enough checkpoint tokens to unlock the Bonus levels can expect 5 new mind blowingly crazy and meme like levels completely outside the style of the other more realistic worlds to be in place. These levels are unlock-able in the game but still under construction. Players that unlock the bonus world before we complete the levels will have them available and already unlocked the second that they drop.

 In addition to the two potential endings (failure ending and success ending) already in place, there will be alternate endings in place if you beat the game having all checkpoint tokens unlocked as well as if you are able to beat the game in hardcore mode. These endings will include the opportunity to perform the extraction from voltanis after firing the missile and will be wild!!!

 We hope to see some youtube videos from you streamers and pro gamers out there that are able to unlock the all token and hardcore mode endings.

 We will knock out every major bug or solid feedback suggestion shared with us on our Discord feedback server. We encourage and appreciate all constructive criticism on the discord server. Everyone reading this manifesto that is interested is invited! 
https://discord.gg/D5sRWnuknf 

 We hope to acquire your help and support in achieving enough over 100 positive reviews which will give us the confidence and reputation necessary to make ports of the game for nintendo switch, mac, and potentially VR.
